description: Returns the hour-by-hour manual traffic counts DfT recorded at one count point on its survey day, by direction of travel, with each direction's busiest hour and 12-hour total. Answers peak-hour questions such as "how busy is this road at 8am" for transport consultants and planning statements. Counts cover one weekday between 07:00 and 19:00 in the survey year, not averages or night-time, and many points are only surveyed every few years. (cost: 1 credit)

count_point_id.description: integer, required, DfT count point id

direction.description: string, optional, N, S, E, W or C (combined); default all directions

year.description: integer, optional, survey year; default is the most recent year with a manual count

name: road_traffic_hourly_counts
